messages:
anya: Heads-up — did a quick link sweep on runbooks/docs this morning. Found 4 broken shortlinks, one runbook (runbooks/alerts/oncall-rotation.md) with no owner, and an API example in runtime-guide that returns 403 in staging. Dropping details below.
docs-bot: link-scan: 4 broken links found under /kb and /runbooks. Report: https://internal/reports/link-scan/2833333333 :mag_right:
anya: Broken list: - /kb/deploy-cheatsheet (shortlink expired) - runbooks/alerts/oncall-rotation.md (owner: none) - runtime-guide/examples/auth-curl.md (curl sample -> 403 in staging) - kb/embed/gist-123 (404)
anya: I've opened a tiny PR that replaces the shortlink with the canonical path and adds an owner placeholder. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/1245 — needs review.
mike: I can take the api snippet fix. Is the 403 due to the auth header change?
anya: Seems likely. The sample uses the old header. Quick fix: update the curl example to use Bearer token. Replace `X-API-KEY: $TOKEN` with `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN`.
anya: Quick patch I used locally:
```
sed -i 's/X-API-KEY: \$TOKEN/Authorization: Bearer \$TOKEN/' runtime-guide/examples/auth-curl.md
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: fix curl auth header" && git push origin docs/fix-curl-auth
```
mike: Thanks — making PR now. pinging @joel for staging deploy if needed.
joel: I can own the oncall-rotation doc for now. I'll add myself to frontmatter and a short note about who to page for infra. @anya can you assign me in the PR?
anya: Done — I added `owner: joel` to frontmatter and left a tiny paragraph noting the rota lead. Also adjusted a redirect for the shortlink.
kate: I can review PR 1245 and the curl PR later today. :thumbsup:
sara: Small nit — when you edit runbooks, please include a `last_updated` date in frontmatter so we can track changes.
joel: Noted, will add `last_updated` when I push the owner commit.
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded for docs site (deploy-2026-03-20-08:37).
mike: PR opened: https://git/repo/pulls/1246 — added curl fix and tested locally against a staging token. PTAL @kate @anya
kate: Reviewed and left 1 inline comment about escaping backticks in the codeblock. Should be a 1-line follow-up.
anya: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge 1245 and 1246 after Kate's follow-up. We'll ship the runbook owner change too. Closing sweep in 24h unless someone objects.
joel: :thumbsup:
sara: thanks!
